Name: Ring Gloves
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[b][size=4]What is a Ring Glove?[/size][/b]
A Ring Glove is a specially crafted piece of equipment that allows the wearer to equip two rings on a single hand. Originally created by advanced mages seeking to better understand the properties and interactions of ring magic.
Despite their ingenuity, the mages who designed them were unable to fully harness the combined power of multiple rings. The magic proved too unstable for direct use. However, the glove itself remains a promising foundation. With the right enhancements, such as those possible from the dwarves, it may be possible to unlock their true potential and safely channel the strength of combined rings.

[b][size=4]Ok, for real though:[/size][/b]
Ring Gloves add two types of gloves that let you wear multiple rings in a single slot (up to 3 if enabled in the config).
The basic glove can be purchased from Marlon after completing all Monster Slayer goals (this requirement can be changed in the config). By default, this glove does [b]not[/b] allow the use of combined rings.
However, you can upgrade it using 1 Galaxy Soul and 99 Cinder Shards in the forge (config can change amounts and the item needed). The upgraded glove removes this restriction, allowing you to equip combined rings as well. So theoretically you can wear 8 (12) rings in total!

Translation:
Like most of my mods I include a translation file for you. All you need to do is change the text in said file to your language and put it back in the lang folder and you will automatically translate the mod.

[size=4]Incompatibilities[/size]:
Any mod that changes how the inventory system works such as the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url] mod as the gloves function more as a key than an actual storage. This mod was made with the intention to create a balanced way to wear more rings so I'm not adding compatibility.
[size=3]Also 'Rings' added by other mods may not work due to how I had to code this mod. [/size]
